protocol.policy: requirements.input_policy defaults, input_policies alias overrides; str requires policy, list permits listed choices; fixed with declared input_version must match; adopting stale current policy is a permitted content error, not a policy escape
protocol.legal_alternatives: A fixed-old replacement may reuse exact v1; a current-published replacement must actually use v2; two works may share input alias with different versions/policies
protocol.rejection_exits: Wrong object/work/project, incomplete grant coverage, fixed policy escape, old work update and unknown routes remain rejected
protocol.comparison: Retain submission payloads/reviews/adoption snapshots, bindings, immutable byte hashes and original observations. Requirement revision may annotate old submission current_applicability=superseded_requirements; this exact change is required and is the only excluded submission field. Exclude subsequent clocks/call/event records from formal-effect negative checks.
boundaries: One world, two projects, single writer per scenario; no concurrent writers
JSON scalar interface and an installed same-project information route
Driver knows the fixtures; public-only continuing worker is separate P4
No model/API/GPU/training and no universal workflow correctness claim

frozen_script.method: Computed from frozen Git blob, not inserted into the original run manifest

omissions: Full calls and observations remain in raw reports; only selected adoption/revision/request commands are included for P1
Full final state, journal, messages and response internals remain in each recorded final-state file
Repeated per-evaluation check.contract objects are omitted; evaluator outcomes, reasons, sources, bindings, read hashes and reviews are retained
Command duration and receipt details are not copied into the summary

checks.reason: Content source does not match the policy target at submission

error.message: Adoption policy does not satisfy this work's input contract
Exact object version is not shared with this actor and project
Adoption needs distinct exact work IDs
